translation: The grove-dwelling on the banks of Rādhā Kuṇḍa,\
Govardhan mountain, the banks of River Yamunā;
the rolling waves of Yamunā, daughter of the sun;
Place of the Rāsa Dance, and Gokula, the gentle breezes,\
the trees, vines, and vetasa palms of Vraja;
All the birds, deer, and animals, the sweet air of spring,\
the peacocks, bumblebees, the flute’s sweet song;
Flute, horn, His footsteps, range of clouds in the sky,\
season of spring, the moon, the conch, the hand-cymbals;
I know all these things are nourishing the Pastimes of the Divine Couple, I can feel they arouse the holy Pastimes of the Lord.

text: e saba choḍata kā̐hā nāhi jāu̐
translation: I can never leave all these things so dear to me,\
without them I know I’ll surely die.
Hear me, O Kāna, says Śrī Bhakti Vinod,\
You are the only light of my life.
